edits.original: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sedom. They don't hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

edits.original: He touched my mouth with it, and said, "Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven."

edits.original: Therefore, by this the iniquity of Ya'akov will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars shall rise no more.

edits.original: Yet it pleased YHWH to bruise him. YHWH has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed. He shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of YHWH shall prosper in his hand.

edits.original: It shall happen, when you shall show this people all these words, and they shall tell you, Why has YHWH pronounced all this great harm against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against YHWH our God?

edits.original: Again, when a righteous person does turn from their righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, they shall die: because you have not given him warning, they shall die in their sin, and their righteous deeds which they have done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at your hand.

edits.original: But when the righteous turns away from their righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked person does, shall they live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.
